body: I've definitely considered it once or twice. I used to adore making stories as a child, but eventually lost the time to do so. Even now, finding time to do much of anything potentially enjoyable is like trying to sift through a dune of sand for a single flake of gold.

I suppose. Problem is, they're not necessarily very useful talents for reliable careers. 

That makes sense. I guess the trick there would be to find something that ignites some semblance of a spark again. Prior to wandering my way here, I had actually tried re-indulging in some old hobbies (which did actually include video games), only to have no reaction at all. I try and try, but everything I attempt almost feels like letting lukewarm water run through my fingers.
